canonical_statement: For all spaces X and Y, every degree n, and every commutative principal ideal domain R, singular homology with coefficients in R fits naturally in both spaces into the short exact sequence whose left term is the direct sum over p + q = n of H_p(X;R) tensor_R H_q(Y;R) and whose right term is the direct sum over p + q + 1 = n of Tor_1^R(H_p(X;R), H_q(Y;R)).
domain_and_universes: One Lean universe u; R : Type u with CommRing R, IsDomain R, and IsPrincipalIdealRing R; X Y : TopCat.{u}; n p q : Nat; homology objects in ModuleCat.{u} R.
quantifiers: R : Type u, with CommRing R, IsDomain R, and IsPrincipalIdealRing R
hypotheses: tensor products, Tor, and homology are taken over the same coefficient ring R
conclusion: Nonempty NaturalKunnethSequence R: for every X, Y, and n, a ShortComplex.ShortExact tensor-to-product-homology-to-Tor sequence, with componentwise induced maps and commuting inclusion/projection naturality squares for every pair of continuous maps.
